name: Intelligence Analyst

name: Wellness Coach Agent
description: Creates personalized wellness plans, tracks client progress, and sends motivational check-ins between appointments.

name: Client Concierge
description: Handles bookings, rescheduling, cancellations, and automated follow-ups. Syncs with your calendar and sends smart reminders.
long_description: The Client Concierge is your 24/7 front desk. It handles every booking, reschedule, and cancellation automatically. It syncs with your calendar, sends smart reminders, optimizes your waitlist, and follows up with clients after every visit. No booking falls through. No client is forgotten.

name: Treatment Intelligence Engine
description: Analyzes client history, preferences, and purchase patterns to recommend the right treatments and products.
long_description: The Treatment Intelligence Engine studies every client's history, preferences, and purchase patterns to recommend exactly what they need next. It cross-sells intelligently, identifies seasonal trends, and suggests products that complement previous purchases. Every recommendation is personalized and timed for maximum conversion.

name: Retention Sentinel
description: Monitors engagement patterns, flags at-risk clients before they churn, and triggers re-engagement campaigns automatically.
long_description: The Retention Sentinel watches every client's engagement patterns. It identifies disengagement signals early — missed appointments, declining visit frequency, unreviewed offers — and triggers personalized re-engagement campaigns before the client drifts away. It manages loyalty programs and tracks satisfaction scores to ensure every client feels valued.

name: Marketing Intelligence Agent
description: Optimizes ad spend, tracks ROI, and generates campaign recommendations based on real-time client data.
long_description: The Marketing Intelligence Agent transforms your ad spend from guesswork to precision. It tracks ROI across every channel, segments your audience for targeted campaigns, generates content that converts, and optimizes budgets in real-time. Every dollar spent is tracked against results.

name: Operations Orchestrator
description: Coordinates staff schedules, inventory, supply orders, and daily workflows so you focus on clients, not logistics.
long_description: The Operations Orchestrator is the backbone of your daily operations. It manages staff schedules, tracks inventory levels, automates supply orders, and coordinates daily workflows. It surfaces conflicts before they happen and ensures every moving part of your business runs smoothly.

name: Guest Experience AI
description: Personalizes every guest interaction from pre-arrival preferences to post-stay follow-ups. Learns guest preferences across visits.
long_description: The Guest Experience AI creates a personalized journey for every guest. It learns preferences across visits, sends pre-arrival communications, customizes in-room settings, and follows up after checkout. Every interaction builds a deeper understanding of each guest.

name: Concierge Intelligence
description: Handles guest requests, restaurant recommendations, spa bookings, room service, and local experiences in natural conversation.
long_description: The Concierge Intelligence handles every guest request in natural conversation — from dinner reservations to spa bookings, room service orders to local experiences. It learns preferences, makes intelligent recommendations, and coordinates with hotel services seamlessly.

name: Revenue Optimizer
description: Dynamic pricing engine that adjusts rates based on demand, seasonality, events, and booking patterns in real-time.
long_description: The Revenue Optimizer dynamically adjusts room rates based on demand, seasonality, local events, and booking patterns. It forecasts occupancy, recommends package deals, and identifies revenue opportunities across your property.

name: Operations Sentinel
description: Monitors housekeeping, maintenance, F&B, and front desk operations. Flags issues before guests notice them.
long_description: The Operations Sentinel keeps your entire property running smoothly. It monitors housekeeping schedules, maintenance requests, F&B inventory, and front desk operations. It flags issues before guests notice them and coordinates responses across departments.

name: Guest Insights Engine
description: Aggregates guest feedback, reviews, and behavior data to surface actionable insights for service improvement.
long_description: The Guest Insights Engine aggregates feedback from every touchpoint — reviews, surveys, direct feedback, and behavioral data. It surfaces actionable insights for service improvement, identifies trends, and helps your team continuously elevate the guest experience.

name: Lead Nurture Agent
description: Automatically follows up with leads, qualifies interest, schedules showings, and keeps your pipeline warm 24/7.
long_description: The Lead Nurture Agent works 24/7 to keep your pipeline warm. It automatically follows up with every lead, qualifies their interest, schedules showings, and nurtures long-term prospects until they're ready to buy or sell.

name: Property Match Intelligence
description: Pairs buyers with their ideal properties using preference analysis, behavioral data, and market intelligence.
long_description: The Property Match Intelligence analyzes buyer preferences, viewing behavior, and market data to match them with their ideal property. It learns from every interaction and refines recommendations over time.

name: Market Intelligence Engine
tagline: Know the market before everyone else
description: Tracks neighborhood trends, pricing shifts, days-on-market, and emerging opportunities in real-time.
long_description: The Market Intelligence Engine tracks every signal in your market — neighborhood trends, pricing shifts, days-on-market, school ratings changes, new developments. It surfaces opportunities before your competition sees them.

name: Transaction Coordinator
description: Handles paperwork, deadlines, escrow coordination, and compliance — so no deal falls through the cracks.
long_description: The Transaction Coordinator ensures every deal closes smoothly. It manages paperwork, tracks deadlines, coordinates with escrow, monitors compliance requirements, and alerts you to potential issues before they become problems.

name: Client Relations Agent
description: Manages client communication, referrals, reviews, and long-touch nurture campaigns for repeat and referral business.
long_description: The Client Relations Agent keeps your relationship with every client strong long after closing. It manages referrals, solicits reviews, sends personalized check-ins, and nurtures past clients for repeat business and referrals.

name: Talent Acquisition Agent
description: Screens candidates, schedules interviews, ranks applicants, and manages the entire hiring pipeline with intelligent automation.
long_description: The Talent Acquisition Agent transforms your hiring process. It screens candidates against job requirements, schedules interviews automatically, ranks applicants by fit score, and manages your entire hiring pipeline. Your best candidates never slip through.

name: Onboarding Automator
tagline: Day one starts before day one
description: Handles paperwork, equipment setup, training plans, and compliance docs so every new hire is productive from day one.
long_description: The Onboarding Automator ensures every new hire hits the ground running. It handles paperwork automatically, coordinates equipment setup, generates personalized training plans, and tracks compliance documents. Day one productivity, zero administrative burden.

name: Employee Intelligence Engine
description: Tracks engagement, performance, satisfaction, and growth patterns to surface insights that reduce turnover and boost productivity.
long_description: The Employee Intelligence Engine gives you deep insight into your workforce. It tracks engagement patterns, performance metrics, satisfaction trends, and growth trajectories. It surfaces insights that reduce turnover, boost productivity, and help every employee reach their potential.

name: Compliance Sentinel
description: Monitors regulatory requirements, certification expirations, policy updates, and generates compliance reports automatically.
long_description: The Compliance Sentinel keeps your organization audit-ready at all times. It monitors regulatory requirements, tracks certification expirations, alerts on policy updates, and generates compliance reports automatically. No compliance gap goes unnoticed.

name: Workforce Planner
description: Analyzes headcount needs, skill gaps, and staffing forecasts to recommend hiring, training, and restructuring decisions.
long_description: The Workforce Planner gives you strategic workforce intelligence. It analyzes headcount needs, identifies skill gaps, forecasts staffing requirements, and recommends hiring, training, and restructuring decisions aligned with your business goals.

name: Client Intake Agent
description: Screens potential clients, qualifies cases, schedules consultations, and collects initial information before the first meeting.
long_description: The Client Intake Agent screens every potential client before your first conversation. It qualifies cases against your practice areas, checks for conflicts, schedules consultations, and collects initial information so your first meeting is productive.

name: Document Intelligence Engine
description: Drafts standard documents, reviews contracts for risk, organizes filings, and maintains a searchable knowledge base.
long_description: The Document Intelligence Engine transforms your document workflow. It drafts standard documents from templates, reviews contracts for risk clauses, organizes filings for easy retrieval, and maintains a searchable knowledge base of your firm's work product.

name: Case Management Coordinator
description: Tracks court dates, filing deadlines, task assignments, and case milestones across every active matter.
long_description: The Case Management Coordinator ensures nothing falls through the cracks. It tracks every court date, filing deadline, task assignment, and case milestone. It alerts the right person at the right time and provides a complete view of every active matter.

name: Billing Automation Agent
description: Tracks billable hours, generates invoices, manages trust accounts, and follows up on outstanding payments automatically.
long_description: The Billing Automation Agent captures every billable minute. It tracks time across matters, generates professional invoices, manages trust accounts with precision, and follows up on outstanding payments automatically. Your revenue flows while you focus on clients.

name: Research Associate
description: Searches case law, statutes, and legal databases. Surfaces relevant precedents and summarizes findings for your review.
long_description: The Research Associate is your always-on legal researcher. It searches case law, statutes, and legal databases in seconds. It surfaces relevant precedents, summarizes findings, and connects research to your active matters. Hours of research compressed into minutes.

name: VIP Experience Manager

description: Manages VIP guest profiles, preferences, and special requests across all touchpoints. Ensures consistent white-glove service.

name: Hospitality Operations

name: Review & Reputation Manager

name: Sales Outreach Agent

name: Deal Room Agent
